messages:
maya (AE): Quick sync — HealthCorp wants a 2-week proof-of-concept restricted to EU only, ideally Germany. They asked: can we prevent any egress outside EU, provide sub-processor list, and support customer-managed keys? Price-sensitive and need to start early next week.

jin (Infra Eng): We can run the POC in eu-central-1 with tenant pinning + dedicated pool to keep data plane in EU. Full BYOK (HSM in-region) is not available immediately; ETA ~3 weeks for HSM onboarding.

lisa (Solutions): For an expedited POC we typically do: dedicated nodes in eu-central-1, explicit egress ACLs, and disable cross-region fallbacks. That covers data plane residency; however control-plane metadata currently lives in our control plane region — we have a private-control-plane option but that needs more lead time.

maya (AE): Customer insists control-plane metadata also stays in EU. Is private control plane doable for a short trial?

jin (Infra Eng): Ops can provision a private control plane in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 but it takes ~7-10 business days for sandbox provisioning and validations. If they waive BYOK and accept EU control plane, we can do a 3 business day turnaround for dedicated pool only.

provision-bot: Auto: Subprocessor inventory for eu-central-1: CloudInfraCo (compute), BlockStoreZ (storage), CDNPartnerEU (edge). Attestation artifacts located: /internal/subproc/eu-central-1.zip

tom (Security): We'll need to update our security questionnaire replies for Data Residency and attach the subprocessor CSV. BYOK requests require HSM integration and vendor attestations. If HealthCorp demands keys retained in DE exclusively, that'll add procurement + legal time.

maya (AE): Can we produce a short attestation PDF for the POC that lists residency controls (data plane in DE, dedicated pool, egress ACLs)? They need this for internal audit.

provision-bot: Auto: Attestation template found at /templates/eu-residency-attestation-template-v2.pdf. Fillable after ops finishes provisioning.

lisa (Solutions): Pricing snapshot for a 2-week dedicated trial: 2 x GPU nodes reserved = ~$6,800 base + geo-fidelity ops surcharge (approx 25%) => ~ $8,500. If they commit to a month, we can lower to ~ $5,900. Finance to confirm exact billing lines.

jin (Infra Eng): Technical caveats: enabling strict geofence and tenant pinning disables cross-region model fallback. Recommend pin to a model build that is fully hosted in DE. Also minor latency delta expected (roughly +10-40ms) depending on client network.

tom (Security): Action items for BYOK/private CP: signed SOW, expedited vendor risk review, legal subprocessor addendum, and HSM procurement timeline. Without those we cannot attest to key locality.

maya (AE): I'll ask HealthCorp: (1) accept EU control plane? (2) require BYOK? (3) approve provisional budget ~ $8.5k for 2 weeks? Also requesting their security questionnaire now.

lisa (Solutions): I'll draft a POC scope paragraph to attach to the SOW: dedicated eu-central-1 pool, tenant_pin=true, geofence routing, egress ACLs, model pinned, no cross-region fallback, attestation on completion.

jin (Infra Eng): For engineers: client config flag example for region lock: ```{"region":"eu-central-1","tenant_pin":true,"fallback":"disabled"}```. Ping me for test API keys with region restrictions.

provision-bot: Auto: Ticket created POC-7894. Estimated earliest start (no BYOK/private CP): 1707379200. With private control plane/BYOK: 1707950400.

maya (AE): Great — I'll push for answers and the signed SOW. Will update thread once HealthCorp replies. :white_check_mark:
